command: set -euo pipefail; adb shell dumpsys package link.localclimate.app | grep -E 'versionName=|versionCode=' | head -n 2; adb shell pidof link.localclimate.app; adb shell dumpsys activity activities | grep -m 1 'link.localclimate.app/.MainActivity'; ! adb logcat -d -v brief '*:E' | grep -E 'FATAL EXCEPTION|ANR in link.localclimate.app'; git rev-parse HEAD; test -z "$(git status --porcelain)"
